name: build-agents-on-aws
description: Design and deploy production-grade AI agents on AWS. Strands Agents SDK design patterns (prompt architecture, tool APIs, interventions, native context management, topology, evals) and Bedrock AgentCore deployment (runtime, MCP Gateway, Identity 2LO/3LO, Cedar Policy, Evaluations, Observability, CDK). Includes a tested, command-scaffolded project template.
